name: Roman Krösbacher
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Roman Krösbacher in Fulpmes – your authentic Tyrolean mountain experience!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, **Fulpmes** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable adventures. Whether you're seeking thrilling hikes, serene nature trails, or world-class skiing, this charming village has it all.

At **Roman Krösbacher**, we invite you to savor the finest flavors of **Tirol**. Indulge in our legendary **Kaiserschmarrn**, freshly baked with a hint of vanilla and dusted with powdered sugar—best enjoyed with a glass of crisp **Apfelstrudel** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee mit Schlag**.

Our rustic **Hausmannskost** (homestyle cooking) features hearty dishes like **Tiroler Gröstl**, **Käsespätzle**, and slow-roasted **Wildschweinbraten** (wild boar). Pair your meal with our selection of local **Bier** (beer) from **Tiroler Brauereien** or a smooth **Grauburgunder** from the nearby vineyards.

After your meal, warm up by the crackling fireplace or take a stroll through the picturesque village. In winter, glide down the slopes of **Ahornbahn** or **Zillertal Arena**, just minutes away. In summer, explore the **Zillertal Valley**’s hiking trails, like the scenic **Fulpmeser Almwiesen** or the challenging **Hochfeiler** ascent.

**Roman Krösbacher**—where tradition meets adventure, and every bite tells a story of **Tirol**. **Willkommen!**
